newsitem.title: USA: Sprint PCS launches service in San Diego.
newsitem.headline: Sprint PCS launches service in San Diego.

text.p: Sprint PCS said Friday it launched its Personal Communication Services (PCS) wireless network in San Diego.
Sprint PCS is a partnership of Sprint Corp, Tele-Communications Inc, Cox Communications Inc and Comcast Corp.
The partnership and affiliates have licenses to provide PCS service in 33 major trading areas with an aggregate population of 190 million.
"The replacement for cellular is here," said Bruce Crair, vice president and general manager for Sprint PCS in Irvine.

Sprint PCS said San Diego was one of the first cities to begin wireless service on the Sprint PCS network. The network, when fully operational next year, will offer digital personal communication services throughout the United States, it said.
Sprint PCS phones are manufactured by Sony Corp / Qualcomm Inc with a suggested retail price of $199, with a $30 service credit applied to a Sprint PCS customer's first bill.
